subject.title: Dashboard: new data-binding kinds — stream, command, computed

question: Should this issue close when the open stream/computed binding PR lands, or should it continue to track a separate security-reviewed `command` binding?
rationale: The issue asks for command execution as a data source, while the linked PR deliberately excludes it for security reasons; automation cannot choose that product/security boundary.

options.title: Close after stream/computed land
options.body: Treat command execution as intentionally deferred and require a separate, security-reviewed proposal before any command binding work starts.

options.title: Keep this issue for command
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical command-binding tracker after stream/computed land, with explicit allowlist and operator-control requirements.

options.title: Reject command bindings
options.body: Accept only stream/computed bindings and mark command-backed dashboard data out of scope unless a maintainer later sponsors the security model.

recommendation.title: Close after stream/computed land
recommendation.body: Treat command execution as intentionally deferred and require a separate, security-reviewed proposal before any command binding work starts.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal is the Control UI plugin-tab seam this dashboard roadmap builds on, and the decision is about accepting a security-sensitive Control UI/plugin capability.
